title: Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation for Efficient Multi-Agent Communication Topology Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.20099v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by coordinating multiple agents, but at the cost of substantial token consumption. Recent work on automatic topology design, ARG-Designer, has reframed this problem as autoregressive graph generation. However, its training objective provides no explicit incentive for the model to generate sparse and efficient topologies. We address this limitation by introducing a Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation (RGA-Designer) inspired by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We train a reward model that jointly captures task correctness and structural compactness, and then fine-tune the pretrained graph generator using the reward model as feedback. Our method preserves task accuracy at the level of ARG-Designer while reducing token consumption by an average of 20.5%.

translated_title: 奖励引导的自回归图生成用于高效多智能体通信拓扑设计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20099v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）通过协调多个智能体在复杂推理任务上表现出强大的性能，但代价是大量的令牌消耗。最近关于自动拓扑设计的工作，ARG-Designer，将这个问题重新定义为自回归图生成。然而，其训练目标并未为模型生成稀疏高效的拓扑提供显式激励。我们通过引入一种受人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）启发的奖励引导自回归图生成（RGA-Designer）来解决这一局限性。我们训练了一个联合捕捉任务正确性和结构紧凑性的奖励模型，然后使用该奖励模型作为反馈对预训练图生成器进行微调。我们的方法在保持ARG-Designer水平任务准确性的同时，平均减少了20.5%的令牌消耗。
tldr: 提出一种奖励引导的自回归图生成方法（RGA-Designer），通过训练奖励模型优化拓扑结构，在保持任务准确性的同时平均减少20.5%的令牌消耗。
en_tdlr: Propose a reward-guided autoregressive graph generation method (RGA-Designer) that optimizes topology structure via a trained reward model, maintaining task accuracy while reducing token consumption by an average of 20.5%.
